title: assets through:
columns:
The Company has inculcated climate risk
mitigation measures in its construction of
new assets and maintenance of existing
assets through:
• Construction of effective drainages for
substations that do not have drainages, as
well as desilting of clogged drainages.
• Replacement of missing cable trench
covers, as these let in water that can
eventually damage the installations at the
substations.
• Installation of automated water pumps in
substations located in wetlands, such as the
Mbale Tangshan Industrial Park Substation.
